title: 2026-11-10 P20 overnight measurement and candidate campaign: RTX 5090 production request-log traffic profile, warm-TTFT tail attribution, and #58 low-acceptance fallback rejection (EXP-110); offline 3,000-turn coding-agent replay declining own-prefix n-gram copy-drafting revival (EXP-111); upstream #434 starvation production controls vs E1 candidate on RTX PRO 6000 proxy and RTX 5090 (EXP-112); cold prefill/decode interference (EXP-077) on RTX PRO 6000 proxy and RTX 5090 (EXP-113); C2 pair K=6144 T=16 Q5 mixer-output attribution on small-T tensor-core sliced-K closing EXP-092's open half (EXP-114); native RTX 3090 keep-warm and RTX 4090 prefill-chunk-2048 configuration probes rejected (EXP-115); native rk4v4 (#60) true-cold restore token-32 divergence reclassified as oracle prefill geometry on RTX 3090 (EXP-116); host-side NFC boundary normalization 11.06x speedup in candidate alphastorm/ninfer#96 with Jinja strip and small-T preload skipped (EXP-117); RTX 5090 shipped-quota (24,576 MiB) EXP-077 arrival-wait control and retained-preferred-source-wait root cause with candidate alphastorm/ninfer#100 (EXP-118); E4 opt-in prefill-pacing curve on RTX PRO 6000 proxy in candidate alphastorm/ninfer#95 (EXP-119); E2 serve robustness (#446/#440/#441/numerical_failure/shutdown) in candidate alphastorm/ninfer#98 (EXP-120); and RTX 5090 DFlash2 C1 greedy byte-identity parity on integrated candidate F (a3fa0550) and council-remediated candidate F2 (bdc665a3 / F3 e0971faf, alphastorm/ninfer#99 and #101) vs production (EXP-121)
evidence_boundary: Maintainer-private raw harness logs, request logs, and transcripts; public summary metrics and cryptographic identities are recorded here, while raw prompts, model outputs, credentials, and private host filesystem paths are excluded. Pre-cut slice, proxy, and integration measurements in E1-E4, integration F, source-wait #100, and council remediation F2/F3 are recorded on their exact measured subjects across fork PRs alphastorm/ninfer#95-#101; runtime v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 subsequently shipped in omp-ninfer v0.17.0 (published 2026-11-10) from fork source F3 e0971faf = integration F a3fa0550 (#99: E1 bounded fresh admission #97, E2 serve robustness #98, E3 NFC #96, and E4 prefill pacing #95 shipped default-off) + council remediation #101 (pending-pressure-save wait and fresh-window budget), while E5 copy drafting (#94, declined, closed) and the arrival source-wait fix (#100, closed unmerged; tracked in alphastorm/ninfer#102) were not shipped, RTX 3090's native post-route compaction campaign failed and was founder-waived with disclosure in v0.17.0 (tracked in alphastorm/ninfer#89), and product tooling follow-ups are tracked in alphastorm/omp-ninfer#149.
question: Across the 2026-11-10 P20 campaign: (1) What do the retained RTX 5090 production request logs (9,430 completions) show for decode/prefill/queue wall shares, overlap slowdown, warm-TTFT tail causes, and the #58 DFlash2 low-acceptance fallback trigger (EXP-110)? (2) Does own-prefix n-gram copy drafting (S1 / E5 alphastorm/ninfer#94) reach the >= 15% pooled session decode bar on a 3,000-turn real coding-agent transcript replay (EXP-111)? (3) Does E1 (alphastorm/ninfer#97, adopting upstream 77c2e5e2 / #443 resume-without-replay semantics plus a bounded fresh-admission rotation window) eliminate both admitted-request starvation (< 5 s pause) and fresh-request HTTP 503 queue timeouts on the RTX PRO 6000 proxy (df7aeb52) and on the RTX 5090 (375bb848) against production controls (EXP-112)? (4) How severe is cold 130K prefill/decode interference (EXP-077) on the e6ac7b70 proxy and on the RTX 5090 (a87de361 production and 375bb848 E1 at the 2,048 MiB scratch checkpoint quota, EXP-113)? (5) Does the e6ac7b70 base still need EXP-092's unmerged 3a2fadbd T=16 K=6144 Q5 pair-mixer port (EXP-114)? (6) Do config-only --gpu-keep-warm-ms 60000 on native RTX 3090 or --prefill-chunk 2048 on native RTX 4090 pass their promotion gates on shipped v0.16.2-v0.17.0 binaries (EXP-115)? (7) Is EXP-107's RTX 3090 rk4v4 (#60) true-cold restore mismatch at token 32 caused by checkpoint transport / kernel numerics or by oracle prefill chunk geometry (EXP-116)? (8) Which host-side TTFT optimizations (NFC boundary normalization, Jinja .strip() edge decode, small-T CUDA module preload) earn inclusion in E3 alphastorm/ninfer#96 (EXP-117)? (9) Does the 21-23 s RTX 5090 EXP-077 arrival wait persist at the shipped 24,576 MiB checkpoint quota, what is its root cause, and does the first source-wait candidate fix (alphastorm/ninfer#100) eliminate the 45 s proxy reproduction (EXP-118)? (10) What co-resident decode and long-wall trade-offs does the E4 opt-in prefill-pacing curve (alphastorm/ninfer#95) achieve on the RTX PRO 6000 proxy (EXP-119)? (11) Does E2 serve robustness (alphastorm/ninfer#98) resolve #446, #440, #441, non-finite numerical failures, and managed final-save shutdown timeouts (EXP-120)? (12) Do integrated F (a3fa0550) and post-council remediated F2 (bdc665a3 / F3 e0971faf, alphastorm/ninfer#101) preserve 3/3 byte-identical DFlash2 C1 greedy parity against production a87de361 on the RTX 5090 (EXP-121)?
answer: EXP-110 (rtx5090-win-a production logs, 9,430 completions 2026-08-25 to 2026-11-04): DFlash2 v0100p+ filtered traffic (production logs from v0.10.0 onward with DFlash2 speculative decoding, excluding diagnostic filenames, deterministic <= 256-token or explicit-request-digest probes, the historical greedy 8,192-10,240-token no-tool corpus signature, and acceptance-window overlaps; 7,318 requests, 55,988.14 s wall) is 69.42% decode / 28.58% prefill / 1.43% queue with 1.31% request overlap; the recent v0.13-v0.16.2 filtered slice (176 of 180 requests, 299.64 s wall) shifts to 31.89% decode / 50.21% prefill / 8.16% queue with 25.57% request overlap and 1.560x median matched elapsed decode slowdown on 8 requests overlapping a peer's pre-first-token window (1.340x on 14 decode-overlap requests), zero >= 60 s global-decode stalls, and zero logged preemptions/replays across all 180 recent completions. Recent cached (= strict-warm <= 1,024 computed tokens, n=112) TTFT p50/p90/p99 is 0.265 / 0.357 / 1.466 s (cold n=64 is 3.451 / 4.821 / 5.939 s); 94.42% of the broad DFlash2 cached top-decile TTFT (n=718) is prefill (673/718 compute > 4,096 tokens), 79.33% of the historical strict-warm top 1% (n=35) is queue wait, and 4 first-after-server-start Host-KV restores account for 84.0% of recent top-decile TTFT above the cohort median (excluding them lowers recent p99 from 1.466 s to 0.376 s). Low-acceptance DFlash2 (< 3 tokens/round) is 3.45% (DFlash2 v0100p+) to 6.26% (recent) of decode time, giving 0.469%-0.851% modelled round-cost recovery (< 3% trigger), so alphastorm/ninfer#58 is dropped. EXP-111 (offline replay of 3,000 nonempty cloud-model coding-agent turns / 1,764,539 Qwen-tokenized output tokens across 649 sessions; 0 local-Qwen turns in the 30-day census): accepted own-prefix copy share is 20.5413% fixed (min match 12; 19.38% payload-only) and 13.2531% with adaptive 12->24->36 backoff, concentrated in edit/hashline arguments (39.76% fixed / 31.52% backoff), formatting (29.20% / 17.49%), other tool arguments (23.87% / 11.24%), bash/eval (23.37% / 15.51%), and write arguments (17.00% / 10.24%) vs visible reasoning (3.61% / 1.70%) and plain text (2.87% / 2.06%). Pooled session decode speedup is 1.06664-1.09314x fixed and 1.05484-1.06928x with backoff (combined x1.055-1.093, or 1.02958-1.05425x / 1.01476-1.02812x with S1's -4.205% short-Read lookup-toll sensitivity), below the >= 15% bar; E5 copy-drafting revival (alphastorm/ninfer#94, d117bc17) was declined, closed, and not shipped in v0.17.0. EXP-112 (E1 in alphastorm/ninfer#97, shipped in RTX 5090 v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 / F3 e0971faf in v0.17.0): on rtxpro6000-win-a, same-session control e6ac7b70 had 1.618474534 s max admitted pause, 6 HTTP 503 timeouts, and 1/2 long requests completing, whereas candidate df7aeb52 (binary c46c67d1) achieved 2.266069104 s max pause (< 5 s), 0 HTTP 503, 2/2 long completions, and 3/3 byte-identical greedy parity on both DFlash2 and MTP3. On rtx5090-win-a (same production serving vector, 146,368 auto BF16 KV, 2,048 MiB scratch quota), production a87de361 (binary cc99a460) paused 367.9977688699946 s (368.62261531799595 s max scheduler pause) and starved the second long request (1/2 completed, 0/54 HTTP 503, fresh TTFT p50/p95 0.292190 / 0.535915 s), whereas E1 candidate 375bb848 (binary 7f988154) passed with 2.9986773779965006 s max fully-paused interval (3.2083587239976623 s pause->recovery), 2/2 40,000-token long completions inside 600 s, 0/51 HTTP 503, and fresh TTFT p50/p95 0.400092 / 3.392509 s. EXP-113 (cold 130K EXP-077 interference): on rtxpro6000-win-a (e6ac7b70, 130,084 cold tokens, 3 repeats), median co-resident decode is 6.375002 tok/s (< 100 tok/s trigger; full-A 20.387571 tok/s, gap p50/p99 350.569854 / 469.988615 ms, long-request wall 46.491205 s, server prefill 44.226679 s) and arrival-during-prefill TTFT is 0.803794 s (< 5 s trigger); on rtx5090-win-a at the 2,048 MiB scratch quota, production a87de361 (6/6 valid cold, arrival submitted at admission + ~5.15 s offsets) measured 5.109089 tok/s co-resident decode (full-A 16.116528 tok/s), gap p50/p99 430.325104 / 618.715558 ms, arrival TTFT 23.071937 s, and long wall 59.960177 / 59.473603 s, and E1 candidate 375bb848 (5/6 valid cold, 2/3 valid arrival) measured 5.127272 tok/s co-resident decode, gap p50/p99 405.190917 / 618.392636 ms, arrival TTFT 20.999604 s (invalid 3rd sample 52.519997 s retained), and long wall 59.891799 / 59.165644 s. EXP-114 (rtxpro6000-win-a Nsight Systems trace on e6ac7b70): in a C2 decode round (743 kernels, 17.838570 ms summed), all 64 K=6144 T=16 LinearAdd mixer calls already run on q5_a16_sliced_k_mma_kernel (320 CTAs, mean 19.767594 us, total 1.265126 ms/round vs EXP-092's 1.41 ms target), so porting 3a2fadbd is unnecessary. EXP-115 (native config probes on shipped v0.16.2-v0.17.0 a87de361): on rtx3090-win-a (binary 15a4db46), --gpu-keep-warm-ms 60000 with the compiled sm_86 3.5/10 ms spin drops to NVIDIA P-states P5 at 12 s and P8 at 30/58 s (+15.4 to +37.9 W held draw) with post-idle TTFT 0.5456 / 0.5667 / 0.6501 s vs 0.4173-0.4212 s back-to-back (median per-observation paired ratios 1.362-1.521x > 1.10x gate, 27/27 identical) and is rejected; on rtx4090-win-a (binary ffee91bf), --prefill-chunk 2048 fits (848.00 MiB available >= 640 MiB) but gains only x1.0236 C1 prefill and x1.0149 130K retrieval (< 1.04 gate), regresses benchmark_c1 decode x0.8818 (254.40 -> 224.33 tok/s), and diverges on 40/84 role84 cases (44/84 cross-arm identity), so it is rejected. EXP-116 (rtx3090-win-a rk4v4 alphastorm/ninfer#60 geometry control on f6ed4381): a cold rk4v4 run replaying the restored arm's capture boundary and suffix prefill geometry (split 3,066, suffix chunks 18, 2, 3, 4 at bases 3066, 3084, 3086, 3089) matches the restored continuation 32/32 tokens (both emit token 32 = 3635, whereas ordinary chunk-1024 cold emits 48117 at token 32; INT8 control is 32/32 three-way identical at 48117, and canonical KV/StateImage transport is byte-exact), reclassifying #60 as oracle prefill geometry rather than a restore or kernel defect. EXP-117 (E3 in alphastorm/ninfer#96, 6f1ae8d2 on e6ac7b70, shipped in RTX 5090 v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 / F3 e0971faf in v0.17.0): boundary-segmented NFC normalization speeds up a 507,749-byte technical document (39,469 non-ASCII bytes) from 5.147875 ms to 0.465583 ms (-90.96%, 11.06x) and a 507,749-byte ASCII control from 0.065500 ms to 0.056375 ms (-13.93%) while matching 100,000 random utf8proc oracle texts, 65/65 serialized results (56 prompts + 9 expected errors), and 564,922/564,922 token IDs; Jinja .strip() edge-only decode (21d8b947) is skipped because base validates interior UTF-8 by contract, and small-T module preload (79d657e0) is skipped as N/A after Nsight tracing on rtxpro6000-win-a measured <= 0.668558 ms cumulative module/lookup API time per request (< 20 ms gate). EXP-118 (rtx5090-win-a shipped-quota EXP-077 control and source-wait root cause): re-running production a87de361 at the shipped 24,576 MiB checkpoint quota (production-exp077-q24-01, 6/6 valid cold) proved the arrival wait persists (arrival TTFT 23.073498 s vs 23.071937 s at 2,048 MiB, delta +0.001561 s; co-resident decode 5.254542 tok/s, gap p50/p99 430.661417 / 618.893977 ms, PDD/DDP long wall 59.710807 / 58.846915 s) and localized the root cause to retained-preferred-source wait (preferred_reused_tokens=111, fallback_reason=none, source_wait_seconds 19.492952 / 23.722483 / 22.305462 s across repeats 1-3); a first candidate fix in stacked PR alphastorm/ninfer#100 (head 7f2c71fd; GPU sm_120a binary at 1c5, sha256 20782176) passed CPU tests (EngineCore 31/31 + ResourceManager, 0.060028 s wait at 60 ms allowance) and CI, but did NOT remove a 3-pair warm-history GPU reproduction on rtxpro6000-win-a (base source_wait 44.750 / 44.859 / 44.877 s vs candidate 44.740 / 44.776 / 44.945 s, candidate TTFT 44.942 / 44.973 / 45.144 s) because engine_core.h:2703 reserves resident units before the fresh scan and try_admit_one:1893 refuses while reclaim occupies the Native context slot (#100 closed unmerged and not shipped; tracked in alphastorm/ninfer#102). EXP-119 (E4 opt-in prefill pacing on rtxpro6000-win-a, alphastorm/ninfer#95): across 7 cold arms against e6ac7b70 (6.375 tok/s, gap p99 469.989 ms, B-submit+1s arrival TTFT 0.619 s, PDD/DDP long wall 46.491 / 45.484 s), co-resident decode scales from 6.600 tok/s (e4-b95f-off) and 6.400 / 12.025 / 24.160 / 47.901 / 73.400 tok/s (k1 / k2 / k4 / k8 / b250-k16) to 103.205 tok/s (b500-k32-v2, gap p99 265.079 ms, arrival 0.628 / 0.654 s, long wall 49.658 / 45.701 s, wall ratios 1.068 / 1.005), but corresponding-repeat C2 outputs differ on every arm (base itself varies across C2 repetitions), so both flags shipped default-off (0) in RTX 5090 v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 (F3 e0971faf, v0.17.0). EXP-120 (E2 serve robustness in alphastorm/ninfer#98, head d191fb57, binary 88bd2265; live GPU proof at 5e73453f, binary 5fd3bdec; shipped in RTX 5090 v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 / F3 e0971faf in v0.17.0): fixes #446 malformed tool-call history (HTTP 200), #440 all 7 reasoning-effort tiers mapped to low/medium/xhigh on unchanged artifact template 81f924d4 (high HTTP 200), #441 disabled thinking with effort (HTTP 200), request-local HTTP 500 numerical_failure recovery on NaN/Inf/OOV (GPU ninfer_sampling_test --nonfinite-only exit 0), and stop/join split + exportable catalog during shutdown (2.570988 s Stop, saved 1 / refused 0 / skipped 0, restored 18 cached tokens vs baseline e6ac7b70 failing with managed final-save deadline exceeded), with 5/5 byte-identical MTP3 parity (6fe9fe7e) and all CI green. EXP-121 (RTX 5090 DFlash2 C1 greedy parity on rtx5090-win-a): integrated candidate F (a3fa0550, binary 1afbb82d, alphastorm/ninfer#99) passed 3/3 byte-identical C1 gating (f-parity-01-pc1 vs fc1) and 3/3 informational C2 (pc2 vs fc2) against production a87de361 (cc99a460); after council CR-20261110T083627Z-a3fa0550 identified a P1 (resident pause hitting a Pending durable pressure save causes pause_reclaim_victim / reserve_resident_units to fail the Engine with 'progress owner cannot obtain its legal unit') and a P2 (failed fresh window not consuming its rotation in take_fresh_window()), both fixed in alphastorm/ninfer#101 (F2 runtime commit bdc665a3, binary 92f0f636; F3 test-only fix e0971faf, EngineCore 35/35, 1,311/1,311 Ninja steps, CI all green), remediated F2 passed 3/3 byte-identical DFlash2 C1 greedy parity against production (f2-parity-01-pc1 vs fc1) and F3 e0971faf shipped as RTX 5090 v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 in omp-ninfer v0.17.0 (published 2026-11-10).

decision.action: Record EXP-110 through EXP-121 and the CR-20261110T083627Z-a3fa0550 council remediation in the public performance ledger and roadmap; drop #58 low-acceptance DFlash2->MTP3 fallback; decline reviving own-prefix copy drafting (E5 PR alphastorm/ninfer#94 closed unmerged and not shipped); close EXP-092's pair-mixer backlog item as already covered on e6ac7b70; reject native RTX 3090 keep-warm (with the compiled sm_86 pattern) and native RTX 4090 chunk 2048; reclassify native rk4v4 (#60) token-32 divergence as oracle prefill geometry pending a founder decision on a geometry-matched durability oracle; ship E1 (#97), E2 (#98), E3 (#96), default-off E4 prefill pacing (#95), integration F (#99), and council remediation F2/F3 (#101, e0971faf) in RTX 5090 v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 in omp-ninfer v0.17.0 (published 2026-11-10); and close stacked arrival source-wait PR #100 unmerged for structural follow-up in alphastorm/ninfer#102.
decision.rule: Each P20 experiment was governed by preregistered promotion or design-trigger bars: EXP-110 #58 fallback trigger >= 3% all-decode-seconds recovery; EXP-111 copy-drafting revival bar >= 15% pooled session decode speedup; EXP-112 #434 starvation green bar < 5 s max fully-paused interval, 0 HTTP 503 queue timeouts, 2/2 long requests completing within 600 s, and 3/3 byte-identical no-pressure greedy parity; EXP-113 EXP-077 pacing design trigger co-resident decode < 100 tok/s or arrival-during-prefill TTFT > 5 s; EXP-114 pair-mixer kernel attribution on C2 decode rounds; EXP-115 native config gates (RTX 3090 post-idle TTFT <= 1.10x back-to-back at 12/30/58 s inside 350 W; RTX 4090 available >= 640 MiB, C1 and 130K prefill >= 1.04x, decode >= 0.98x, and 84/84 byte identity); EXP-116 32-token three-way cold/restored/matched-geometry control with byte-exact transport verification; EXP-117 byte-identical 65/65 serialized results (56 prompts + 9 expected errors) / 564,922-token-ID frontend parity and >= 20 ms first-use CUDA module-load threshold; EXP-118 shipped-quota (24,576 MiB) arrival-wait control and 3-pair warm-history GPU source-wait reproduction; EXP-119 C2 cold pacing curve (co-resident >= 100 tok/s, arrivals < 2 s, long wall <= 1.15x, byte-identical outputs required for default-on promotion); EXP-120 HTTP 200 on #446/#440/#441, request-local 500 numerical_failure isolation, managed Stop completion + restore, and 5/5 MTP3 byte parity; EXP-121 3/3 byte-identical DFlash2 C1 greedy parity on RTX 5090.
decision.verdict: EXP-110: #58 fallback DROPPED (0.469%-0.851% decode recovery < 3%); interference confirmed as top recent real-traffic runtime lever (25.57% overlap, 1.560x slowdown). EXP-111: copy-drafting revival DECLINED and NOT SHIPPED in v0.17.0 (x1.055-1.093 pooled decode < 1.15 bar; E5 PR #94 closed). EXP-112: E1 (PR #97) GREEN on both rtxpro6000-win-a (df7aeb52: 2.27 s max pause, 0 HTTP 503 vs 6 on e6ac7b70 control, 2/2 long complete, 3/3 DFlash2 and MTP3 greedy parity) and rtx5090-win-a (375bb848: 3.0 s max fully-paused interval vs 368.0 s production control, 2/2 long complete, 0/51 HTTP 503) and SHIPPED in RTX 5090 beta.6 (F3 e0971faf, v0.17.0). EXP-113: interference trigger TRUE on proxy (6.375 tok/s co-resident decode, 0.804 s arrival TTFT, 46.49 s long wall / 44.23 s server prefill) and on rtx5090-win-a (5.11 tok/s production / 5.13 tok/s E1 co-resident decode; 23.07 s / 21.00 s arrival TTFT at 2,048 MiB scratch quota). EXP-114: pair-mixer port NOT NEEDED (already on small-T sliced-K at 19.77 us/call, 1.27 ms/round). EXP-115: native RTX 3090 keep-warm REJECTED (drops to P5/P8, 1.362-1.521x TTFT ratio) and native RTX 4090 chunk 2048 REJECTED (x1.0236 / x1.0149 prefill, x0.8818 benchmark decode, 44/84 cross-arm identity). EXP-116: rk4v4 #60 RECLASSIFIED as oracle prefill geometry (32/32 matched-geometry cold == restored). EXP-117: NFC boundary fix PORTED in PR #96 (5.15 -> 0.47 ms, 11.06x, 65/65 serialized results and 564,922 token IDs identical) and SHIPPED in RTX 5090 beta.6 (F3 e0971faf, v0.17.0); Jinja strip and small-T preload (<= 0.67 ms < 20 ms) SKIPPED. EXP-118: RTX 5090 arrival wait PERSISTS at shipped 24,576 MiB quota (23.073498 s, delta +0.001561 s; root cause = 19.49-23.72 s retained-preferred-source wait); PR #100 (7f2c71fd / 1c5) did NOT remove the 45 s proxy reproduction (44.740-44.945 s vs 44.750-44.877 s base), was CLOSED UNMERGED (not shipped), and is tracked in alphastorm/ninfer#102. EXP-119: E4 pacing (PR #95) reaches 103.205 tok/s co-resident decode at b500-k32-v2 (+6.8% PDD long wall), but C2 outputs differ across repeats; SHIPPED DEFAULT-OFF (0) in RTX 5090 beta.6 (F3 e0971faf, v0.17.0). EXP-120: E2 serve robustness (PR #98, d191fb57 / 5e73453f) PASSES CPU/GPU/HTTP resilience (2.571 s Stop vs base timeout, 18 cached tokens restored, 5/5 MTP3 parity, CI green) and SHIPPED in RTX 5090 beta.6 (F3 e0971faf, v0.17.0). EXP-121: RTX 5090 DFlash2 C1 greedy parity PASSES 3/3 byte-identical on both integrated F (a3fa0550, binary 1afbb82d, plus 3/3 informational C2) and council-remediated F2 (bdc665a3, binary 92f0f636, runtime-identical to F3 e0971faf in PR #101, SHIPPED as RTX 5090 v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6 in omp-ninfer v0.17.0 on 2026-11-10).
decision.reason: Decisions follow directly from measured P20 hardware and log/corpus receipts without unverified extrapolations.
decision.not_decided_here: Native Windows re-cut incorporating the F3 (e0971faf) runtime fixes and resolving the RTX 3090 native compaction-campaign residual (founder-waived with disclosure in v0.17.0, tracked in alphastorm/ninfer#89; product tooling follow-ups in alphastorm/omp-ninfer#149), structural fix for the retained-preferred-source arrival wait (alphastorm/ninfer#102 after #100 closed unmerged), and founder disposition of a geometry-matched true-cold durability oracle for native rk4v4.
